html:
Voting for the IdleCorp bot will allow more potentially new players to see the bot on Discord bot listing sites. At the time of writing, IdleCorp is only listed on Top.GG (Discord Bots List): https://top.gg/bot/601241235474350122

Contents

  • 1 Voter's Boon
  • 2 Gratitude Points
    • 2.1 Corporation name
    • 2.2 Corporation motto
    • 2.3 Research

Voter's Boon[edit]

As a reward for voting, corporations with voter's boon active will receive 25% faster production rates across all facilities, as well as a 10% increase on the hourly buy limit. Each vote also grants 1x gratitude point, $1,000.00, and 200 Pass XP.

Gratitude Points[edit]

Gratitude points are a reward for voting and are global across all regions. Gratitude points can currently be spent on changing your corporation's name or motto, or for instantly completing research, the latter being the only thing that helps your corporation in a non-cosmetic way.

Corporation name[edit]

A corporation's name can be changed by spending 2x gratitude points with the following command: $$name <name>

For example, changing a corporation's name to "My Corporation": $$name My Corporation

Corporation motto[edit]

A corporation's motto can be changed by spending 1x gratitude points with the following command: $$motto <motto>

For example, changing a corporation's name to "Hello World": $$motto Hello World

Research[edit]

A corporation can choose to expedite its research by spending 4x gratitude points with the following command: $$res and clicking the checkmark that appears.
